[NDET.2.2] The first five strings are compile-time constants (program-lifetime).
`backends` is engine-lifetime: one entry per registered series-backend slot, in
slot-id order. Each backend's compile-time identity affects sample-state
evolution, so it is part of the signature
([NSBK.7]). **Copy before retaining**
across `ds_engine_free`.

The engine must write each entry as `<atom>:<backend_name>:<backend_version>`,
where `<atom>` is the body message of the backing's atom in [RDSC.7.1]. The
entries are [NDET.2.5]'s.
